summary: A single tick box with its label, in three sizes, three shapes and three shadows, with indeterminate, disabled and read-only states.

props.name: label
props.description: The text beside the box. The whole thing is one `<label>`, so clicking the text toggles it.

props.name: description
props.description: A second line under the label, indented to line up with it. Use it for the consequence of ticking the box, not for a restatement of the label.

props.name: size
props.description: Box, tick and label together. The description's indent follows, so it stays aligned with the label at every size.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`, which degrades to a rounded square where that is unsupported.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Depth on the box. `inset` reads as a well, `outset` as a raised control.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Starting state when you are not controlling it. Pair `checked` with `onCheckedChange` instead if you are.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled state. Passing it without `onCheckedChange` gives a box that cannot be ticked; `readOnly` is the honest way to say that.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new state. Required for a controlled checkbox.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Neither on nor off, for a parent whose children disagree. Draws a dash in a filled box, because an empty box would read as "off", which is the one thing it does not mean.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the whole row, label included.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows a value without offering to change it. Unlike `disabled` it stays focusable and is not dimmed, so it can still be read.

props.name: className
props.description: Appended to the box's classes, so any Yumma CSS utility you pass wins.
